notes: No value in this project is typed in from memory or inferred. Every number on the site is either (a) computed by pipeline/ scripts from the CSV files in data/, or (b) transcribed from an official nfl.com page and stored next to its source_url in data/official/.
Transcriptions from nfl.com contain only W/L/T/PF/PA. Playoff-seeding glyphs and streaks shown on the page were deliberately not transcribed.
NFL-sourced standings values are NOT stored in this repository (F-10). data/official/verification_attestation.json records only counts, team codes, URLs and the attestation date.
